forbidden_permissions: unfiltered session or system bus access
network access without a product requirement

applications.authority: User-selected documents and printing cross XDG portals; recovery and application state remain inside the application XDG directories.
Portal-backed import/export is suitable, but the running application has not yet adopted its reserved Wayland application identity or completed Linux acceptance evidence.
The file manager intentionally owns broad user-visible filesystem, mount, trash, metadata, and host application-opening authority.
A terminal intentionally launches the user's host shell and controls PTYs, child processes, signals, and the current host filesystem.
System Monitor requires truthful host process, CPU, memory, network, storage, and signal authority that a sandbox deliberately hides.
The application catalog must read host desktop-entry precedence and activate arbitrary reviewed host applications.
System Settings intentionally coordinates system D-Bus, polkit, hardware, session configuration, package, privacy, and service authorities.
